comment: Cook mode: closes the screen. VoiceOver label of the X button at the top, and a button on the last page and in the error states.
Cook mode, while the assistant writes the recipe: one of a few lines that rotate every few seconds under the meal's name. Says honestly what is happening. Ends with an ellipsis.
es: Leyendo la comida de tu plan…

comment: Cook mode, while the assistant writes the recipe: a rotating line. The assistant is writing short, simple steps.
Cook mode, while the assistant writes the recipe: a rotating line. The assistant picks what could replace each ingredient.
Cook mode, while the assistant writes the recipe: a rotating line shown only when the person listed foods they avoid in Settings.
Cook mode, before anything is sent: title of the card that asks to share this meal with the assistant so it can write the recipe. Tapping it opens the consent alert.
en: Share this meal to get its recipe
tr: Tarifini almak için bu öğünü paylaş
es: Comparte esta comida para recibir su receta

comment: Cook mode, under the consent card's title: exactly what is sent to the assistant. Must stay accurate: name, description, portion, and the foods the person avoids; nothing else.
en: To write the steps, the meal’s name, description and portion, and any foods you avoid, are sent to the assistant. Nothing else about you or your plan is sent.
tr: Adımları yazabilmesi için öğünün adı, açıklaması ve porsiyonu ile kaçındığın besinler asistana gönderilir. Seninle ya da planınla ilgili başka hiçbir şey gönderilmez.
es: Para escribir los pasos, se envían al asistente el nombre, la descripción y la porción de la comida, y los alimentos que evitas. No se envía nada más sobre ti ni sobre tu plan.

comment: Cook mode: title when this month's recipe allowance is used up. The Plus screen is shown separately; this is the calm state behind it.
en: This month’s recipes are used up
es: Ya usaste las recetas de este mes

comment: Cook mode, under the 'recipes are used up' title: recipes opened before still open without using anything.
en: Recipes you have opened before still open for free.
tr: Daha önce açtığın tarifler yine ücretsiz açılır.
es: Las recetas que ya abriste se siguen abriendo gratis.

comment: Cook mode, 'recipes are used up' state, free tier only: button that opens the DietFlow Plus screen. 'Plus' is the product name.
Cook mode: title when the recipe could not be written (no connection, service busy…). A reason and a Try Again button follow.
en: The recipe could not be written
es: No se pudo escribir la receta

comment: Cook mode, under a failure reason: reassures that the failed attempt did not use one of the month's assistant uses.
en: Nothing was taken from your AI uses.
es: No se descontó ningún uso del asistente.

comment: Cook mode, failure state: asks the assistant for the recipe again.
Cook mode failure reason: the assistant could not be reached.
en: The assistant could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
tr: Asistana ulaşılamadı. Bağlantını kontrol edip tekrar dene.
es: No se pudo contactar con el asistente. Revisa tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.

comment: Cook mode failure reason: too many requests just now.
en: The assistant is busy just now. Try again in a minute.
tr: Asistan şu an yoğun. Bir dakika sonra tekrar dene.
es: El asistente está ocupado ahora. Inténtalo de nuevo en un minuto.

comment: Cook mode failure reason: this phone reached the server's daily request limit.
en: That is as many requests as one day allows. Try again tomorrow.
tr: Bir günde yapılabilecek istek sayısına ulaştın. Yarın tekrar dene.
es: Has alcanzado el máximo de solicitudes por día. Inténtalo mañana.

comment: Cook mode failure reason: the meal's description is longer than the assistant reads at once.
en: This meal’s description is longer than the assistant reads at once. Shorten it and try again.
tr: Bu öğünün açıklaması asistanın tek seferde okuyabileceğinden uzun. Kısaltıp tekrar dene.
es: La descripción de esta comida es más larga de lo que el asistente lee de una vez. Acórtala e inténtalo de nuevo.

comment: Cook mode failure reason: the assistant found nothing it could cook in the meal's name and description.
en: The assistant could not find a dish to cook in this meal.
tr: Asistan bu öğünde pişirilecek bir yemek bulamadı.
es: El asistente no encontró un plato que cocinar en esta comida.

comment: Cook mode failure reason: the service is down or answered with something unreadable.
en: The assistant is not available right now.
es: El asistente no está disponible ahora.

comment: Cook mode: title when the meal is no longer in the plan.
Cook mode: message when the meal is no longer in the plan.
en: This meal is no longer in your plan.
es: Esta comida ya no está en tu plan.

comment: Cook mode: a short chip with a clock symbol giving minutes, for the whole recipe or one step. %lld is the number of minutes, e.g. '25 min'. Keep the abbreviation short.
Cook mode: chip saying how hard the recipe is. One word.
Cook mode: chip saying how hard the recipe is: in between. One word.
Cook mode: chip saying how hard the recipe is: takes some skill. One word.
Cook mode: VoiceOver name of the servings stepper (swipe up or down to change it).
Cook mode: the number of servings in the stepper between − and +. %lld is the number, 1 to 8.
Cook mode, card shown after changing the number of servings to one not written yet: explains that this needs a new recipe from the assistant.
en: A different number of servings is a new recipe.
tr: Farklı porsiyon sayısı yeni bir tarif demek.
es: Otro número de raciones es una receta nueva.

comment: Cook mode: assistant button that asks for the recipe again for a new number of servings. Its cost is shown under it. %lld is the number of servings.
Cook mode: keeps the recipe for the current number of servings instead of asking for a new one.
Cook mode: chip showing the foods the person said they avoid (from Settings), as they typed them. %@ is their text, e.g. 'Avoiding: peanuts, milk'.
Cook mode: heading of the ingredient checklist.
Cook mode, beside the Ingredients heading: how many ingredients the person has ticked off. %1$lld ticked, %2$lld in all, e.g. '3 of 8 ready'.
Cook mode: VoiceOver value of an ingredient the person has ticked off as ready.
Cook mode: small button beside an ingredient that opens what could replace it. %lld is how many swaps, 1 to 3.
Cook mode: VoiceOver label of the swaps button. %@ is the ingredient's name as the recipe wrote it, e.g. 'Swaps for chicken breast'.

Cook mode: fixed line under the ingredients and in the swaps sheet. The assistant does not know the person's allergies or their dietitian's advice. Must stay a plain safety reminder, not a health claim.
en: Check ingredients and swaps against your allergies and your dietitian’s advice.
tr: Malzemeleri ve alternatiflerini alerjilerine ve diyetisyeninin önerilerine göre kontrol et.
es: Revisa los ingredientes y las alternativas según tus alergias y los consejos de tu dietista.

comment: Cook mode: heading of the assistant's short cooking tips.
Cook mode: the main button on the overview; moves to the first step.
Cook mode: title of the half-height sheet listing what could replace one ingredient.
Cook mode, swaps sheet: section header naming the ingredient being replaced. %@ is its name and amount as written, e.g. 'Instead of Chicken breast · 150 g'.
Cook mode: closes the swaps sheet.
Cook mode, swaps sheet footer, next to an 'Estimated' mark: the kcal differences are the assistant's estimates.
en: Energy differences are estimates for the amounts shown.
tr: Enerji farkları gösterilen miktarlar için tahminidir.
es: Las diferencias de energía son estimaciones para las cantidades indicadas.

comment: Cook mode, swaps sheet: small badge when a swap has about the same energy as the original. Very short; '≈' means about.
Cook mode, swaps sheet: VoiceOver reading of a badge like '−40 kcal'. %@ is the energy with its unit, e.g. '40 kcal'.
Cook mode, swaps sheet: VoiceOver reading of a badge like '+120 kcal'. %@ is the energy with its unit, e.g. '120 kcal'.
Cook mode, swaps sheet: VoiceOver reading of the '≈ Same' badge.
es: Más o menos la misma energía

comment: Cook mode, above each step: where the person is. %1$lld is this step, %2$lld the number of steps, e.g. 'Step 3 of 6'.
Cook mode: large button at the bottom that goes to the previous step.
Cook mode: large button at the bottom that goes to the next step.
Cook mode: the Next button on the last step; goes to the closing page.
Cook mode: toolbar toggle (a speaker symbol) that reads each step aloud when it appears.
Cook mode: what is spoken when reading a step aloud. %1$lld is the step number, %2$@ the step's text as the assistant wrote it.
Cook mode: one word above a step saying what kind of step it is: getting things ready.
Cook mode: one word above a step: cutting or chopping.
Cook mode: one word above a step: mixing or stirring.
Cook mode: one word above a step: heating a pan or oven.
Cook mode: one word above a step: boiling or simmering in water.
Cook mode: one word above a step: frying or sautéing in a pan.
Cook mode: one word above a step: baking in the oven.
Cook mode: one word above a step: grilling.
Cook mode: one word above a step: blending in a blender.
Cook mode: one word above a step: letting food rest or stand.
Cook mode: one word above a step: cooling or chilling.
Cook mode: one word above a step: seasoning with salt, spices or herbs.
Cook mode: one word above a step: putting it on the plate and serving.
Cook mode: button on a step that involves waiting; starts a countdown. %lld is minutes, e.g. 'Start Timer · 12 min'.
Cook mode: VoiceOver label of the Start Timer button. %lld is minutes.
Cook mode: VoiceOver label of the X beside a running countdown; stops it.
Cook mode: what a step's timer chip says when the countdown has ended. Short.
Cook mode: VoiceOver hint of the 'Time's Up' chip: tapping it clears it.
Notification title when a cook-mode timer ends (only if notifications are already allowed).
Notification body when a cook-mode timer ends. %1$lld is the step number, %2$@ the step's text as the assistant wrote it.
Cook mode, last page: a warm word when the cooking is done, as people say before eating. Turkish 'Afiyet olsun!', Spanish '¡Buen provecho!'.
Cook mode, last page, under 'Enjoy!'.
Cook mode, last page: marks this meal as eaten for the day and closes cook mode. Turkish must be 'Yedim'.
Cook mode, last page: this meal is already marked as eaten today.
Cook mode, last page, when cooking a later day's meal ahead: it can be marked as eaten on its day.
en: You can mark it as eaten on its day.
es: Podrás marcarla como hecha ese día.
